name: veh-apc-floor-stages
note: E31 L9-S5: the L9 mission APC (floor policy) at 100 / 75 / 50 / 25 / 0 percent durability, left to right, game camera on the 0 percent vehicle. Look for: every hull keeps its shape and wheels grounded, the 0 percent and 25 percent hulls show the existing smoke puffs (heavy smoke stage), none of them is swapped for the wrecked shell, burned or exploded, no fire, and the 0 percent vehicle sits still but stays an intact driveable body. (APC dents, glass and light overlays belong to L9-A1.)
